newsitem.title: CHINA: China banks give tobacco firm 160 mln yuan loans.
newsitem.headline: China banks give tobacco firm 160 mln yuan loans.

text.p: Five commercial banks in Wuhan, capital of the central Chinese province of Hubei, have granted 160 million yuan ($19.3 million) in loans to Wuhan Tobacco Group Co, a company official said on Wednesday.
"It is part of state enterprise reform. The bank is pouring in more loans to help the development of large-scale enterprises," the official told Reuters by telephone.
More than one-third of new, working capital loans extended by banks in Wuhan city this year were to key state enterprises, the China Securities newspaper said.
Wuhan decided in the second half of 1995 to ensure the solvency of 15 key state-owned enterprises, the newspaper said but did not give further details.
